title: Swap sqlx fetch_one for fetch_optional
summary: Take an unknown email as an Option and answer 401, fold row.get into FromRow, then trip on a NULL column.

turns.user: login with an email that isnt registered gives 500. should be 401. also all those row.get lines are annoying

assistant.body: Here's what happens. fetch_one returns RowNotFound when there is no row, ? turns that into AppError::Database, and that answers 500. A missing row is the normal case here, so fetch_optional hands back an Option<Account> instead. The row.get lines become #[derive(sqlx::FromRow)] with query_as. An unknown email and a wrong password both answer the same 401, which ensures nobody can probe which emails exist.

turns.user: ok works. while youre there put display_name in the response too, its for the header

assistant.body: Sure. display_name goes into the SELECT, and the same field goes onto Account and LoginResponse. FromRow matches columns to fields by name, so it is important to keep the two names identical.

turns.user: some accounts get 500 now. log says error occurred while decoding column "display_name": unexpected null; try decoding as an `Option`

assistant.body: Apologies, I missed that display_name is a nullable column. sqlx cannot decode NULL into a String and reports it as a ColumnDecode error. Both structs take Option<String> instead. serde writes None as null, so the frontend should treat null as an empty name.
sed -i '' 's/pub display_name: String/pub display_name: Option<String>/' src/accounts.rs
